name: codex-ssh
description: Operate configured SSH servers directly from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Import OpenSSH hosts, then operate servers from Codex.
interface.longDescription: A local MCP server for Codex that imports concrete hosts from ~/.ssh/config on first run. It can add or remove plugin-managed machine profiles, run commands, manage files, and transfer data. Credentials stay in the local plugin config or key files and are not exposed through tool results.
defaultPrompt: Import my OpenSSH hosts, list them, then inspect the requested server.
Run a read-only health check on one of my configured SSH servers.
